chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Jamīl ibn Ṣāliḥ, from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام concerning His, the Exalted, saying:
"You shall most certainly ride from one state to another state."
He عليه السلام said: "O Zurārah, did not this community, after its Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, ride from one state to another in the matter of so-and-so, and so-and-so, and so-and-so?"

key_terms.أَمْرِ: the matter or affair, here referring to authority/leadership
key_terms.بَعْدَ نَبِيِّهَا: after its Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.فُلَانٍ: so-and-so; an indirect reference to specific persons
key_terms.لَتَرْكَبُنَّ: you shall most certainly undergo or move through

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام explain the verse "لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَنْ طَبَقٍ" in relation to the Muslim community after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام interprets the verse as referring to successive changes and stages that befell this community after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. In this narration, the verse is applied to the community’s progression through disputed leadership matters, highlighting a significant dimension of wilayah and post-Prophetic authority.
